lemon.note: Use the same amount of juice.
Use half the amount; it is sharper.

lime.note: Use the same amount of juice.

milk.sub: water plus a little extra butter
milk.note: Works in pancakes; slightly less rich.

egg.sub: 1 tbsp ground flax plus 3 tbsp water
egg.note: Works for pancakes and baking only. Let it sit 5 minutes.

eggs.note: For fried rice only; cook until hot throughout.

chicken breast.note: Cook a few minutes longer; still cook to 165°F (74°C).
Press and pan-fry until golden; skip the poultry temperature check.

chicken thighs.note: Cooks faster; cook to 165°F (74°C) and do not overcook.

rice.note: Use the same amount; simmer about 15 minutes.
Pour boiling water over, cover 5 minutes.

cooked rice.note: Chill it first, same as rice.

spaghetti.note: Adjust the time to the package.

pasta.note: Adjust the time to the package.

garlic.note: Use 1/4 tsp per clove; add with the other seasonings.

ginger.note: Use 1/4 tsp per tablespoon of fresh.

cheese.note: Mozzarella, cheddar or jack all work.

coconut milk.note: Use 1:1; less coconut flavor, not vegan.

chili flakes.note: Use a pinch; it is milder.

baking powder.sub: 1/4 tsp baking soda plus 1/2 tsp lemon juice per tsp
